I saw this Onox product in the Footsmart catalog & tried it. I spray his feet with this product before he puts his feet into any shoes, including his slippers & we do not have smelly shoes anymore! I love this product and recommend it to everyone!!!

One spray in the morning and my feet are dry and scent free for the whole day.  I had tried many products before and this is the only one that has worked so well.

Love this stuff.  Not only do my feet no longer smell, neither do my shoes.  I spray it on every morning, and yeah, it's a wet spray, but I just put my shoes and/or socks on right after I spray, and I'm good to go.

My podiatrist gave this to me and then stopped selling it so I was thrilled to find it here. Please never stop making it! <3  Also bonus my feet are softer and less dry.

reviews.t: No more odor but skin still peeling...
reviews.x: I have been using this spray between toes after showering since it was delivered a couple weeks ago. It definitely and completely stopped all foot odor which is pretty impressive. Some said it stopped skin peeling which it has not done for me, though cracking and bleeding is less. I'll keep using and see if more time using helps. My major problem was the skin peeling, odor was minor, so unless peeling improves I may not buy it again.

I wear compression hosiery at work, and the feet of the hose get very smelly. I had tried a Lavilin foot deodorant product that worked very well, but it was a white cream that made streaks on the hose, and cost $19 for less than half an ounce. I tried this, but I really don't feel like it ever worked. It helped the smell a little, but at the end of the day, it was definitely still there. I guess I will keep looking.

reviews.t: I like to have a minimum of three bottles on hand ...
reviews.x: This works REALLY well at eliminating foot odor. My son and I both suffer from stinky feet, especially when wearing sandals that get wet. I can now, finally, wear sandals and boots all day without worrying about stinky feet. I like to have a minimum of three bottles on hand for convenience - one for my bathroom, one for my son's bathroom and one to fill a small sprayer (I use the small eye glass cleaner bottle I got from the eye Dr.) for travel.

Before I found Onox, I tried a ton of different things to try and combat the dreaded smell!  Nothing really worked, and I've had to throw a ton of pairs of shoes away due to irreversible stink.  Some reviewers said that it didn't make their feet any dryer, and that is true, it just totally neutralizes the smell.  Onox totally works for me and now I don't have to dread taking my shoes off in public, or worry about ruining cute summer shoes!

reviews.t: The best foot spray to keep feet dry
reviews.x: Fantastic food spray.  Keeps toes dry.  I have sweaty toes and skin would always turn white between them. I never had fungus feet.  I've used all sorts of ointments needlessly.  Until my foot Dr. recommended I use ONOX and it worked wonders.  Spray twice a day once at night after shower and once in morning.  Your feet will be dry, no white patches between because the dead skin sloths off eventually.  I love the stuff.

claims.text: Most reviewers say the spray effectively stops foot odor and sweating, often calling it a miracle or life-changing.
Several reviewers note the spray goes on as a wet liquid rather than a powder, and some find it stays wet or doesn't dry quickly.
A few reviewers mention the product is expensive or wish it were cheaper or Prime-eligible.
Some reviewers report it reduced sweating but not perfectly, or that it didn't fully work for them.
A few reviewers mention additional benefits like reduced skin cracking or relief from athletes foot.
